# The upstream releases legs 1-2 of scripts/verify_ail.sh are EXPECTED to resolve.
# A resolved release outside this set prints one non-fatal notice; it can never red the gate.
#
# Two entries, because legs 1-2 legitimately resolve two different releases by lane:
#   v0.33.0 — upstream `releases/latest`, which CI's `ailang-code verify gate` job installs on
#             PATH and does NOT override (ci.yml exports only WORLD_PKG_AILANG_BIN). Ratified
#             ruling `9/OD-10` clause (a): legs 1-2 TRACK RELEASED versions.
#   v0.30.0 — the documented local pin (CLAUDE.md, charter Verification Log). Operators export
#             AILANG_BIN to this binary, so it is the token the local lane resolves.
#
#   v0.41.0 — the local pin FROM 2026-09-21, attended. It replaced v0.30.0 for the world-package
#             lane because the registry grew publish quality gates after that package froze, and
#             v0.30.0's tarball builder does not include CHANGELOG.md (measured: 9156 bytes vs
#             9785 for the identical tree), so PUB001 was unsatisfiable through it however the
#             file was authored. Reviewed rather than assumed: world/core's contentHash and
#             interfaceHash are BYTE-IDENTICAL across the two compilers (sha256:0c8c6061… and
#             sha256:d16cc882…, 53 signatures) — only compilerVersion and the tarball moved, and
#             the tarball moved because it gained a file. The full package gate passes 9/9 on it.
#
# v0.30.0 is RETAINED, not superseded: the replay goldens are still v0.30.0-scoped and that pin
# deliberately did not move. Two pins, two reasons to be frozen.
#
# Adding an entry is a REVIEW, not a formality: it records that someone looked at what the primary
# .ail gate switched to. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored; an empty set fails the gate loudly.
v0.41.0
v0.33.0
v0.30.0
